note: Key/Value Field provides two field types (key_value = plain, extends StringItem; key_value_long = formatted, extends TextLongItem), two widgets (key_value_textfield, key_value_textarea), and one formatter (key_value with a value_only boolean). Each item stores key/value/description properties; storage setting key_max_length (default 255) sizes the indexed key column. No configure route, no permission, no Drush. Medium cases seed a real key_value field with a known key_max_length (42) and a real formatter value_only=TRUE and have the agent read the live field.storage / view-display config; hard cases have the agent create a key_value field and flip the formatter's value_only setting, verified against the live config entities.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module key_value_field provides field types for storing a key/value pair. What are the machine names of the two field types it defines, and what default widget does each use?
evals.expected_output: key_value (Key / Value plain, plain-text value, default widget key_value_textfield) and key_value_long (Key / Value long, formatted value with a text format, default widget key_value_textarea). Both default to the key_value formatter.

evals.prompt: What sub-values does a single key_value_field item store, and which storage setting controls the length of the key column?
evals.expected_output: Each item stores three properties: key, value, and an optional description (plus format on key_value_long). The key column length is set by the key_max_length storage setting (default 255), and the key column is indexed.

evals.prompt: Using key_value_field, how do I display only the value of a Key/Value field and hide the key when the field is rendered?
evals.expected_output: On Manage display, use the 'Key Value' (key_value) formatter and tick its 'Value only' option (setting value_only = TRUE). With it off the formatter renders 'key : value'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Key/Value field named field_kvf_known. Inspect the live field storage configuration and tell me the maximum length configured for its key.
evals.expected_output: key_max_length is 42: field.storage.node.field_kvf_known settings.key_max_length = 42. Discoverable via drush cget field.storage.node.field_kvf_known.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Key/Value field field_kvf_fmt. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me whether its output shows the key or only the value, and which formatter setting determines that.
evals.expected_output: It shows only the value: the key_value formatter on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default has settings.value_only = true, so the key is hidden.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Key/Value field named field_kvf_task (use the key_value field type) to the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig node.field_kvf_task of type key_value (or key_value_long) plus a FieldConfig on the article bundle. Create via the Manage fields UI or FieldStorageConfig::create()/FieldConfig::create().

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Key/Value field field_kvf_disp whose display currently shows 'key : value'. Configure its display so only the value is shown (hide the key), and apply the change to the live default view display.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_kvf_disp component uses the key_value formatter with settings.value_only = true. Set via Manage display ('Value only' checkbox) or the entity_display API.
